exactFullLexicons.format: RSKP v1 pair of RSKF v1 front-coded lexicons, block size 16

challenge.intent: every challenge token is labelled Keep; any Correct is an unsafe change. Noise is unknown intent excluded from both full lexicons, not proven non-words. Ambiguous keys come from the full lexicons (oracle metadata). No heuristic gates are derived from these results.
challenge.noiseRule: attempt i: d = SHA-256(noise_seed || 0x00 || ASCII decimal i), i = 0,1,...; us layout first, then ru continues the counter; length = 4 + d[0] mod 13; key j = d[1+j] mod 33 (small modulo bias); keys in either full lexicon and duplicates are rejected; at most 100000 attempts in total across both layouts (ru receives the budget left after us)

definitions: valid = natural token, intent Keep, native layout; wrong = synthetic copy of a native letter-only token typed in the other layout; ambiguous = canonical key in both full lexicons, reported only in ambiguousValid/ambiguousWrong and any change there is unsafe; length = canonical keys if supported, else UTF-16 length; unique types = first occurrence per (language, role, canonical keys) or exact text when unsupported; membership is relative to the case's typed layout

dictionaries.processing: experiment-001 helpers: Hunspell stems, lowercase letter-only 1..32, affixes not expanded; full lexicons = all approved dictionary keys; train = splitForKeys == Train

hypothesisEvidence.H1: compare singleD/twoScore recovered vs exactTrain/exactFull in methods.*.occurrences.byFullMembership.neither and byTrainMembership.neither, with unsafe changes
hypothesisEvidence.H4: challenge.*.methods singleD vs twoScore changes, pairwise.singleD.vsTwoScore, and natural recoveries
hypothesisEvidence.verdict: not computed by this tool; the result report states supported/refuted/inconclusive

latency.methodology: warm, single thread. Sample: every k-th natural evaluation case in deterministic order, at most 2000 (k = max(1, cases/2000)); live paths are checked to equal the evaluated decisions first. One warm-up pass. pNN = nearest-rank percentile over cases of the mean of 32 back-to-back calls on that case (QElapsedTimer overhead included, amortized over 32 calls); not single-keystroke latency. batchedMeanNs = one timer over 32 passes of the whole sample divided by calls. fullDecisionPaths include canonicalizeToken (normalization) on every call; precanonicalizedLookups exclude it. QSet is an in-memory hash reference, not a compact format.

limitations: Tatoeba CC0 example sentences selected by the protocol, not an ordinary user input distribution; exact lexicons are built from the same dictionary source as training, not from the evaluation source, and evaluation words are not forced into them, so literal overlap with evaluation tokens is expected and measured, not guaranteed; no affix expansion and no optimized FST baseline; repeated words are not independent trials and no statistical confidence is claimed; oracle token boundaries and case-preserving synthetic errors

pairwise.definition: paired over identical cases: addedRecoveries = method Recovered and baseline not; lostRecoveries = reverse; addedUnsafeChanges = method unsafe (false change, wrong conversion or ambiguous change) and baseline not; preventedUnsafeChanges = reverse

thresholds.calibration: none; fixed by protocol from experiment 001

protocol.validation: exact deep match with the frozen protocol document

resources.boundary: front-coded sorted canonical keys, 16 keys per block, binary search over decoded first keys and exact comparison; a simple experimental structure, NOT an optimized industry FST/DAFSA. residentStructureBytes = container payload of payload + offsets + first-key directory, excluding allocator overhead; not RSS. Process RSS, peak and cold start are measured only by an external monitor of separate --probe child processes. qCompress is a storage reference only.

scope: local evaluation only; aggregate counts, hashes, sizes and timings; no words, sentences, IDs or paths; automatic input stays disabled

sources.verified: protocol, both manifests, all source sizes and SHA-256 and all notice SHA-256 were verified before any parsing; all four source hashes are distinct; sentence IDs do not overlap across languages
